Haa Meem
Yeh Khuda-e-Azeez o Hakeem ki naazil ki hui kitaab hai

Hum ne aasmaan o zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki tamaam makhlooqaat ko haq ke saath aur ek muqarrara muddat ke saath paida kiya hai, aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya woh un baaton se kinaara-kash ho gaye hain jin se inhein daraaya gaya hai

To aap keh dein ke kya tum ne un logon ko dekha hai jinhein Khuda ko chhod kar pukaarte ho? Zara mujhe bhi dikhlaao ke unhon ne zameen mein kya paida kiya hai ya un ki aasmaan mein kya shirkat hai. Phir agar tum sachche ho to is se pehle ki koi kitaab ya ilm ka koi baqiyya hamaare saamne pesh karo
Aur us se zyaada gumraah kaun hai jo Khuda ko chhod kar un ko pukaarta hai jo qiyaamat tak us ki aawaaz ka jawaab nahin de sakte hain, aur un ki aawaaz ki taraf se ghaafil bhi hain
Aur jab saare log qiyaamat mein mahshoor honge to yeh ma'bood un ke dushman ho jaayenge aur un ki ibaadat ka inkaar karne lagenge
Aur jab un ke saamne hamaari raushan aayaat ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to yeh kuffaar haq ke aane ke baad us ke baare mein yahi kehte hain ke yeh khula hua jaadoo hai

To kya yeh log yeh kehte hain ke Rasool ne iftira kiya hai? To aap keh dijiye ke agar main ne iftira kiya hai to tum mere kaam aane waale nahin ho, aur Khuda khoob jaanta hai ke tum us ke baare mein kya kya baatein karte ho, aur mere aur tumhaare darmiyaan gawaahi ke liye wahi kaafi hai, aur wahi bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aap keh dijiye ke main koi naye qism ka rasool nahin hoon, aur mujhe nahin maaloom ke mere aur tumhaare saath kya bartaao kiya jaaega. Main to sirf wahi-e-Ilaahi ka ittibaa' karta hoon aur sirf waazeh taur par azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala hoon

Keh dijiye ke tumhaara kya khayaal hai agar yeh Quran Allah ki taraf se hai aur tum ne us ka inkaar kar diya, jab ke Bani Israaeel ka ek gawaah aisi hi baat ki gawaahi de chuka hai aur woh imaan bhi laaya hai, aur phir bhi tum ne ghuroor se kaam liya hai. Beshak Allah zaalimeen ki hidaayat karne waala nahin hai

Aur yeh kuffaar imaan waalon se kehte hain ke agar yeh deen behtar hota to yeh log hum se aage us ki taraf na daud padte. Aur jab un logon ne khud hidaayat nahin haasil ki to ab kehte hain ke yeh bahut puraana jhooth hai

Aur is se pehle Moosa alaihis-salaam ki kitaab thi jo rehnuma aur rehmat thi, aur yeh kitaab Arabi zabaan mein sab ki tasdeeq karne waali hai taake zulm karne waalon ko azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraaye, aur yeh nek kirdaaron ke liye mujassama-e-bashaarat hai
Beshak jin logon ne Allah ko apna Rab kaha aur usi par jame rahe un ke liye na koi khauf hai aur na woh ranjeeda hone waale hain
Yahi log dar-haqeeqat Jannat waale hain aur usi mein hamesha rehne waale hain, ke yahi un ke aamaal ki haqeeqi jaza hai

Aur hum ne insaan ko us ke maa baap ke saath nek bartaao karne ki naseehat ki, ke us ki maa ne bade ranj ke saath use shikam mein rakha hai aur phir badi takleef ke saath paida kiya hai, aur us ke haml aur doodh badhaai ka kul zamaana tees maheene ka hai. Yahaan tak ke jab woh tawaanaai ko pahunch gaya aur chaalees baras ka ho gaya to us ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri us ne'mat ka shukriya ada karoon jo tu ne mujhe aur mere waalidain ko ata ki hai, aur aisa nek amal karoon ke tu raazi ho jaaye, aur meri zurriyat mein bhi salaah o taqwa qaraar de, ke main teri hi taraf mutawajjeh hoon aur tere farmaanbardaar bandon mein hoon

Yahi woh log hain jin ke behtareen aamaal ko hum qubool karte hain aur un ki buraaiyon se darguzar karte hain. Yeh ashaab-e-Jannat mein hain, aur yeh Khuda ka woh waada hai jo un se baraabar kiya ja raha tha

Aur jis ne apne maa baap se yeh kaha ke tumhaare liye haif hai ke tum mujhe is baat se daraate ho ke main dobaara qabr se nikaala jaaoonga, haalaanke mujh se pehle bahut si qaumein guzar chuki hain. Aur woh dono faryaad kar rahe the ke yeh badi afsos-naak baat hai, beta imaan le aa, Khuda ka waada bilkul sachcha hai. To kehne laga ke yeh sab puraane logon ke afsaane hain
Yahi woh log hain jin par azaab saabit ho chuka hai un ummaton mein jo insaan o jinnaat mein un se pehle guzar chuki hain, ke beshak yeh sab ghaate mein rehne waale hain
Aur har ek ke liye us ke aamaal ke mutaabiq darajaat honge, aur yeh is liye ke Khuda un ke aamaal ka poora poora badla de de, aur un par kisi tarah ka zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Aur jis din kuffaar ko Jahannam ke saamne pesh kiya jaaega (kaha jaaega) ke tum ne apne saare maze duniya hi ki zindagi mein le liye aur wahaan aaraam kar liya, to aaj zillat ke azaab ki saza di jaaegi, ke tum roo-e-zameen mein bila-wajah akad rahe the aur apne Parwardigar ke ahkaam ki naafarmaani kar rahe the

Aur qaum-e-Aad ke bhai Hood ko yaad kijiye ke unhon ne apni qaum ko Ahqaaf mein daraaya, aur un ke qabl o ba'd bahut se paighambar guzar chuke hain, ke khabardaar Allah ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karo, main tumhaare baare mein ek bade sakht din ke azaab se khaufzada hoon
Un logon ne kaha ke kya tum isi liye aaye ho ke humein hamaare khudaaon se munharif kar do? To us azaab ko le aao jis se humein dara rahe ho agar apni baat mein sachche ho
Unhon ne kaha ke ilm to bas Khuda ke paas hai, aur main usi ke paighaam ko pahuncha deta hoon jo mere hawaale kiya gaya hai, lekin main tumhein bahar-haal jaahil qaum samajh raha hoon

Us ke baad jab un logon ne baadal ko dekha ke un ki waadiyon ki taraf chala aa raha hai to kehne lage ke yeh baadal hamaare oopar barasne waala hai. Haalaanke yeh wahi azaab hai jis ki tumhein jaldi thi, yeh wahi hawa hai jis ke andar dardnaak azaab hai
Yeh hukm-e-Khuda se har shai ko tabaah o barbaad kar degi. Nateeja yeh hua ke siwaaye makaanaat ke kuch na nazar aaya, aur hum isi tarah mujrim qaum ko saza diya karte hain

Aur yaqeenan hum ne un ko woh ikhtiyaaraat diye the jo tum ko nahin diye hain, aur un ke liye kaan, aankh, dil sab qaraar diye the, lekin na unhein kaanon ne koi faaida pahunchaaya aur na aankhon aur dilon ne, ke woh aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar karne waale afraad the, aur unhein us azaab ne gher liya jis ka woh mazaaq udaaya karte the
Aur yaqeenan hum ne tumhaare gird bahut si bastiyon ko tabaah kar diya hai aur apni nishaaniyon ko palat palat kar dikhlaaya hai ke shaayad yeh haq ki taraf waapas aa jaayein

To woh log un ke kaam kyon nahin aaye jin ko unhon ne Khuda ko chhod kar waseela-e-taqarrub ke taur par khuda bana liya tha? Balke woh to ghaaib hi ho gaye, aur yeh un logon ka woh jhooth aur iftira hai jo woh baraabar tayyaar kiya karte the

Aur jab hum ne jinnaat mein se ek giroh ko aap ki taraf mutawajjeh kiya ke Quran sunein, to jab woh haazir hue to aapas mein kehne lage ke khaamoshi se suno. Phir jab tilaawat tamaam ho gayi to fauran palat kar apni qaum ki taraf daraane waale ban kar aa gaye

Kehne lage ke aye qaum waalo! Hum ne ek kitaab ko suna hai jo Moosa alaihis-salaam ke baad naazil hui hai. Yeh apne pehle waali kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waali hai, aur haq o insaaf aur seedhe raaste ki taraf hidaayat karne waali hai
Qaum waalo! Allah ki taraf daawat dene waale ki aawaaz par labbaik kaho aur us par imaan le aao taake Allah tumhaare gunaahon ko bakhsh de aur tumhein dardnaak azaab se panaah de de

Aur jo bhi Daai-e-Ilaahi ki aawaaz par labbaik nahin kahega woh roo-e-zameen par Khuda ko aajiz nahin kar sakta hai, aur us ke liye Khuda ke ilaawa koi sarparast bhi nahin hai. Beshak yeh log khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala hain

Kya unhon ne nahin dekha ke jis Khuda ne aasmaan o zameen ko paida kiya hai aur woh un ki takhleeq se aajiz nahin tha, woh is baat par bhi qaadir hai ke murdon ko zinda kar de, ke yaqeenan woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Aur jis din yeh kuffaar Jahannam ke saamne pesh kiye jaayenge (aur poochha jaaega) ke kya yeh haq nahin hai, to sab kahenge ke beshak, Parwardigar ki qasam yeh sab haq hai. To irshaad hoga ke ab azaab ka maza chakho ke tum pehle us ka inkaar kar rahe the

Paighambar! Aap isi tarah sabr karein jis tarah pehle ke saahibaan-e-azm rasoolon ne sabr kiya hai, aur azaab ke liye jaldi na karein. Yeh log jis din bhi us azaab ko dekhenge jis se daraaya ja raha hai to aisa mehsoos karenge jaise duniya mein ek din ki ek ghadi hi thehre hain. Yeh Quran itmaam-e-hujjat hai, aur kya faasiqon ke ilaawa kisi aur qaum ko halaak kiya jaaega
